[Protests](https://zeteo.com/p/iran-protests-trump-threatens-
military?utm_source=publication-search) in Iran have
[spread](https://www.cnn.com/2026/01/12/middleeast/iran-mass-protests-
explained-intl) across all 31 of its provinces, many are feared to be dead,
and Donald Trump is saying, "Help is on the way." Will the US strike Iran
([again](https://zeteo.com/p/six-ways-trumps-bombing-of-iran-
made?utm_source=publication-search))? What is the 'end game'? Is the Iranian
government on the brink of collapse? Why are these mass protests taking place
now? If you're looking for answers to these questions and more, **join us
TODAY at 4pm ET for a live Town Hall Q &A**.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe?)

**Prem** will talk to two experts on Iran about the state of their home
country, what they've been seeing and hearing, and the role foreign actors are
playing:

**Negar Mortazavi** is the Editor and Host of 'The Iran Podcast' and **Sina
Toossi** is a senior nonresident fellow at the Center for International
Policy.

Join us at **4pm ET / 1pm PT / 9pm GMT** and come with your questions on this
rapidly developing story.

**Paid subscribers** can use the link at the bottom of the page to register
for this important and timely town hall. Not a paid subscriber? It's not too
